# bioexcel/biobb_pdb_tools/biobb_pdb_selres

## Summary

Selects residues by their index, piecewise or in a range.

Works by selecting residues based on their index. Can select individual residues, a range of residues, or residues at regular intervals.

Nextflow adapter of the [Pdbselres](https://biobb-pdb-tools.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pdb_tools.html#module-pdb_tools.biobb_pdb_selres) building block of [biobb_pdb_tools](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pdb_tools) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PDB_TOOLS_BIOBB_PDB_SELRES } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pdb_tools/biobb_pdb_selres'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PDB_TOOLS_BIOBB_PDB_SELRES(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_file_path` | yes | pdb | Input PDB file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_file_path` | yes | pdb | PDB file with selected residues |
| `versions_biobb_pdb_tools` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pdb_tools', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Pdbselres properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_file_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pdb_tools container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PDB_TOOLS_BIOBB_PDB_SELRES' {
        ext.properties = [binary_path: 'pdb_selres']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | null | Residue selection format: individual residues "1,2,4,6", range "1:10", multiple ranges "1:10,20:30", open ranges "1:", ":5", or intervals "::5", "1:10:5". |
| `binary_path` | string | "pdb_selres" | Path to the pdb_selres executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
